title: Listen Live: Coco Gauff vs. Mirra Andreeva US Open Match on SiriusXM
summary: Follow the 2026 US Open with live match play-by-play from Flushing Meadows on SiriusXM.
body_markdown:
Women’s tennis stars Coco Gauff and Mirra Andreeva continue their[2026 US Open](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/us-open-tennis) campaigns in a highly anticipated quarter-final match — and SiriusXM listeners can follow the action live on Wednesday, September 9 at 12:40pm ET from Arthur Ashe Stadium in Flushing, New York.


Throughout the tournament, listen to live US Open tennis coverage on satellite Ch. 392 and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogUSOpenTennis) .


[Coco Gauff vs. Mirra Andreeva Live match play-by-play Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogUSOpenTennis)


## 2026 US Open


### How to Listen to the US Open Live


Listen to live US Open match play-by-play on satellite Ch. 392 and[the SiriusXM app with your smart device](https://sxm.app.link/BlogUSOpenTennis) .


### 2026 US Open Men’s and Women’s Singles Schedule


Sunday, August 30–Wednesday, September 2 Men’s and Women’s Singles 1st Round


Wednesday, September 2–Thursday, September 3 Men’s and Women’s Singles 2nd Round


Friday, September 4–Saturday, September 5 Men’s and Women’s Singles 3rd Round


Sunday, September 6–Monday, September 7 Men’s and Women’s Round of 16


Tuesday, September 8–Wednesday, September 9 Men’s and Women’s Quarterfinals


Thursday, September 10 Women’s Semifinals


Friday, September 11 Men’s Semifinals


Saturday, September 12 Women’s Final


Sunday, September 13 Men’s Final
